method: Immutable versioned NBA hypothesis registry; registering an idea does not modify production logic, and exploratory/backtest evidence is not prospective validation.

entries.title: Off-OT fade
entries.question: Going forward from 2026-11-28, does this frozen rule beat its blind same-side baseline? Bet against a team whose last game went to overtime.
entries.origin: 2026-11-28 in-season sweep of 151 filters (project doc claude/NBA_signal_sweep_2026-11-28.md); frozen at Michael's request
entries.frozen_rule: Team A's previous game went to OT and team B's did not: bet team B on the spread. No bet when both or neither did.
entries.bet_point: DraftKings 7 AM CT game-lines pull (FanDuel if no DK)
entries.data_needs: OT from games.json periods (box-score minutes fallback); national TV from ESPN broadcast names
entries.notes: Discovery evidence only before the freeze date (pre-freeze record is shown on the Signals tab). 2017-18 to 2025-26 at the consensus closing line, -110: 52.5% on 1,030 bets, +0.3% ROI, positive in 5 of 9 seasons. Records after the freeze are the prospective test. Definition frozen: change only by adding a new versioned thesis.

entries.title: Off-OT starter unders
entries.question: Going forward from 2026-11-28, does this frozen rule beat its blind same-side baseline? Starters' prop Unders the game after their team's OT game.
entries.origin: 2026-11-28 in-season sweep of 151 filters (project doc claude/NBA_signal_sweep_2026-11-28.md); frozen at Michael's request
entries.frozen_rule: Player started his previous game and his team's previous game went to OT: Under on points, rebounds, assists and threes.
entries.bet_point: DraftKings ~1 h pre-game prop capture (FanDuel if no DK); morning-only lines not graded
entries.notes: Discovery evidence only before the freeze date (pre-freeze record is shown on the Signals tab). No prop history before this season. In the sweep: points and threes did best, rebounds worst (about -18%). Records after the freeze are the prospective test. Definition frozen: change only by adding a new versioned thesis.

entries.title: Hot-shooter points under
entries.question: Going forward from 2026-11-28, does this frozen rule beat its blind same-side baseline? Points Under when a player's last-5 FG% is 8+ points above his season FG%.

entries.frozen_rule: Last 5 games FG% minus season-to-date FG% is 0.08 or more, with 50+ FGA on the season: points Under.
